mentions.name: 3D-Printed Eyeglass Frames
mentions.description: A DIY project to design and 3D-print custom eyeglass frames using CAD. The first goal is printable frames for reading glasses to wear in bed while reading, so replacement frames can be printed and lenses popped in if they break.
mentions.problem: The creator struggled to find glasses frames that fit well after starting to wear glasses, and breakage while falling asleep with them on.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm learning CAD so I can 3d-print my own set of frames.

My first goal is to 3d-print frames for reading glasses that I can wear in bed while I read. This way, if I fall asleep with them on and break them, I can just print new frames and pop the lenses in.
